title: Azido-Functionalized Aromatic Phosphonate Esters in RPOSS-Cage-Supported Lanthanide Ion (Ln = La, Nd, Dy, Er) Coordination

synthesis.procedure: Concerted deprotonation–metalation of an iBuPOSS cage with lanthanum(III) isopropoxide in dry THF under argon (Schlenk/glovebox) gives P1 as a white solid (series P1–P6 isolable yields 86–97%). Solution-state DOSY supports a THF-containing dimer.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Volatiles removed in vacuo; residue washed with pentane.

source_locations.location: Supporting Information, Experimental Section, synthesis of P1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: iBuPOSS-supported neodymium precursor (Nd analogue of P1)

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to P1–P6 by deprotonation–metalation of iBuPOSS with neodymium(III) isopropoxide in dry THF under argon; isolated as a colored solid in the 86–97% yield range for the precursor series.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Volatiles removed in vacuo; residue washed with pentane.

properties.summary: Nd3+ complexes of this family show metal-centered absorption; precursor photoluminescence is discussed mainly for the PhPOSS Nd species P5 rather than P2.

measurements.name: Nd3+ absorption band maximum (series)
measurements.conditions: rt; 300–850 nm range for Nd/Dy/Er complexes

source_locations.location: Supporting Information, Experimental Section, synthesis of P2

synthesis.procedure: Precursor P3 is obtained by deprotonation–metalation of iBuPOSS with erbium(III) isopropoxide in dry THF (P1–P6 yields 86–97%). Crystallization of P3 from dry pentanes at −20 °C affords the tetrameric oxo complex with two partially protonated POSS cages; incorporated water is attributed to traces in the POSS starting material.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: From a solution of P3 in dry pentanes at −20 °C.
synthesis.yield: 86–97% (P1–P6 precursor series; tetramer yield not separately reported)

properties.summary: Er3+ complexes show typical Er3+ absorption (λabs,max ≈ 521 nm) but no metal-centered emission near 1550 nm was detected for the Er series.

source_locations.location: Supporting Information, Experimental Section, synthesis of P3

synthesis.procedure: Deprotonation–metalation of PhPOSS with lanthanum(III) isopropoxide in dry THF under argon. DOSY of P4 indicates a dimer without coordinated THF in solution.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Volatiles removed in vacuo; residue washed with pentane.

source_locations.location: Supporting Information, Experimental Section, synthesis of P4

synthesis.procedure: PhPOSS plus neodymium(III) isopropoxide in dry THF gives P5. Vapor diffusion of pentanes into a concentrated THF solution at −20 °C yields the solid-state dimer [Nd{PhPOSS}(THF)2]2 (monoclinic P21/c).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: vapor diffusion of pentanes into THF
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Vapor diffusion of pentanes into a concentrated solution of P5 in THF at −20 °C.

properties.summary: μ-PL of P5 shows three Nd3+ metal-centered emission bands assigned to 4F3/2 → 4I9/2, 4I11/2 and 4I13/2, analogous to phosphonate-only Nd model complexes.

measurements.name: Nd3+ μ-PL transitions
measurements.conditions: rt μ-PL; λexc = 750 nm; 50 mW; ~1 μm spot

source_locations.location: Emission Properties of Nd3+ and Er3+; Conclusions
Supporting Information, Experimental Section, synthesis of P5

synthesis.procedure: Analogous P1–P6 deprotonation–metalation of PhPOSS with erbium(III) isopropoxide in dry THF under argon.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Volatiles removed in vacuo; residue washed with pentane.

properties.summary: Er3+ absorption typical of the series; no Er-centered NIR emission near 1550 nm detected.

source_locations.location: Supporting Information, Experimental Section, synthesis of P6

synthesis.procedure: In situ generated lanthanide POSS precursor plus azido phosphonate ester L1 (typical loading 3 equiv in this L1 series) in THF under argon; complexes 1–30 isolated as oils/waxes/solids in 73–88% yield. DOSY supports a mononuclear La species.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Brownish-orange viscous oils or sticky waxes for most 1–19/23–30.

synthesis.procedure: In situ Nd–iBuPOSS precursor plus L1 (3 equiv in the L1 series) under argon; 1–30 yields 73–88%.

properties.summary: Exemplary absorption spectrum; μ-PL shows three Nd3+ emission bands (4F3/2 → 4I9/2, 4I11/2, 4I13/2).

synthesis.procedure: In situ Dy–iBuPOSS precursor (Dy(OiPr)3 + iBuPOSS) plus L1; series yield 73–88%.

properties.summary: Dy3+ absorption (λabs,max ≈ 802 nm). μ-PL (λexc 355 nm) shows only broad ligand emission 400–800 nm covering possible Dy-centered bands; no LMCT amplification.

synthesis.procedure: In situ Er–iBuPOSS precursor plus L1; series yield 73–88%.

properties.summary: Exemplary Er3+ absorption; no metal-centered emission near 1550 nm detected for Er complexes.

synthesis.procedure: In situ La–PhPOSS precursor plus L1 (3 equiv); DOSY supports mononuclear formulation.
In situ Nd–PhPOSS precursor plus L1; series yield 73–88%.

properties.summary: μ-PL shows three Nd3+ metal-centered emission bands.

synthesis.procedure: In situ Dy–PhPOSS precursor plus L1; series yield 73–88%.

properties.summary: μ-PL shows only broad ligand emission 400–800 nm.

synthesis.procedure: In situ Er–PhPOSS precursor plus L1. Crystals suitable for SCXRD were obtained; monoclinic P21, 6-coordinate distorted octahedron via tridentate PhPOSS and three P=O donors of L1.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Only complex 8 among 1–30 afforded SCXRD-quality crystals.

properties.summary: Er3+ absorption of the series; no Er-centered emission near 1550 nm.

synthesis.procedure: For L2 chemistry a 2:1 mixture of L2 and 4-bromo analogue S1 was used to supply enough phosphonate for complexation of the in situ POSS–La precursor.
In situ Nd–iBuPOSS plus 2:1 L2/S1 mixture; series yield 73–88%.

properties.summary: Nd3+ μ-PL with three metal-centered bands.

synthesis.procedure: In situ Dy–iBuPOSS plus 2:1 L2/S1. Ambient moisture slowly decomposes 11 to tetramer 31.

properties.summary: μ-PL: broad ligand emission 400–800 nm only.

synthesis.procedure: In situ Er–iBuPOSS plus 2:1 L2/S1. Ambient moisture converts 12 to tetramer 32.

properties.summary: Er absorption of the series; no 1550 nm metal-centered emission.

material_class.structural_family: μ3-OH bridged tetramer with partially decomposed POSS (T7/T6) cages

synthesis.procedure: Handling of [Dy{iBuPOSS}(L2)2(S1)] (11) under ambient conditions leads to slow airborne-water-induced partial T7(O−)3 cage decomposition, affording the μ3-OH-bridged tetramer 31. Not a designed stoichiometric synthesis; no reagent amounts given.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solid-state structure obtained under ambient conditions.

properties.summary: Parent complex 11 shows only ligand-centered μ-PL; 31 is a hydrolysis product and is not separately photophysically quantified beyond structural metrics (M–O distances).

source_locations.location: Supporting Information, Experimental Section, formation of 31

material_class.structural_family: μ3-OH bridged tetramer with partially decomposed POSS (T7/T6) cages

synthesis.procedure: Ambient moisture-induced partial POSS-cage decomposition of [Er{iBuPOSS}(L2)2(S1)] (12) yields μ3-OH-bridged tetramer 32.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solid-state structure obtained under ambient conditions.

properties.summary: Er complexes of the paper lack metal-centered emission near 1550 nm; 32 is a hydrolysis product characterized structurally.

source_locations.location: Supporting Information, Experimental Section, formation of 32
